headline.title: Ferrari is using IBM’s AI to create F1 superfans
headline.summary: Ferrari is collaborating with IBM to enhance the Formula 1 fan experience through the use of artificial intelligence. The partnership aims to create more engaging and personalized interactions for superfans of Scuderia Ferrari.

articles.title: Elon Musk has given up on solar power (on Earth)
articles.summary: Elon Musk's xAI has shifted its focus from solar power to natural gas, while SpaceX is concentrating on developing orbital data centers. This change raises questions about the future of Musk's vision for a "solar-electric economy."

articles.title: Google’s new anything-to-anything AI model is wild
articles.summary: Google has introduced a new AI model capable of generating content across various formats, referred to as "anything-to-anything." This model allows users to create diverse media, including deepfakes, by transforming images and videos into different representations.

articles.title: Catch up on the Dialogues stage at Google I/O 2026.
articles.summary: At Google I/O 2026, Alphabet CEO Sundar Pichai participated in a discussion on the Dialogues stage, addressing key topics related to the company's vision and future initiatives. The event highlighted Google's ongoing commitment to innovation and technology advancements.

articles.title: AOP-Wiki EMOD 3.0: Data Model Expansions and Content Evaluation Framework for Using Agentic AI to Improve Integration between AOPs and New Approach Methodologies (NAMs)
articles.summary: The AOP-Wiki has released EMOD 3.0, which expands its data model and introduces a content evaluation framework aimed at enhancing the integration of Adverse Outcome Pathways (AOPs) with New Approach Methodologies (NAMs). This update supports the use of agentic AI to improve the application of in vitro and in silico methods in chemical regulatory assessments.

articles.title: Trace2Skill: Verifier-Guided Skill Evolution for Long-Context EDA Agents
articles.summary: Trace2Skill is a new framework designed to enhance hardware LLM agents' performance on Complex Verilog Design Problems (CVDP) by guiding skill evolution through verifier feedback. The approach allows for improvements without the need for specialized model fine-tuning, focusing on efficiently managing large repository snapshots and addressing hidden-verifier failures.

articles.title: S2ED: From Story to Executable Descriptions for Consistency-Aware Story Illustration
articles.summary: The article presents S2ED, a novel framework designed to enhance multi-frame story illustration by converting full narratives into a sequence of editable executable descriptions. This approach aims to improve long-horizon coherence and consistency in character identity and layout across illustrations without requiring additional training.

articles.title: Search-E1: Self-Distillation Drives Self-Evolution in Search-Augmented Reasoning
articles.summary: The article discusses a new approach called Search-E1, which utilizes self-distillation to enhance the performance of search-augmented reasoning agents post-training. This method aims to improve the efficiency and effectiveness of language models by integrating external supervision and additional modules without relying solely on traditional techniques.

articles.title: Gated DeltaNet-2: Decoupling Erase and Write in Linear Attention
articles.summary: The article introduces Gated DeltaNet-2, a model that enhances linear attention by effectively decoupling the erase and write processes in memory management. It builds on Delta-rule models and Kimi Delta Attention to improve the editing of compressed memory while maintaining existing associations.

articles.title: CR4T: Rewrite-Based Guardrails for Adolescent LLM Safety
articles.summary: The article discusses CR4T, a new framework for enhancing the safety of large language models (LLMs) in adolescent digital environments by implementing rewrite-based guardrails. This approach aims to provide constructive guidance rather than relying solely on suppression methods, which can hinder effective communication and support for young users.

articles.title: Virtual 3D H&E Staining from Phase-contrast Back-illumination Interference Tomography
articles.summary: Researchers have developed a method using Back-illumination Interference Tomography (BIT) to create virtual 3D H&E stained images from unprocessed tissue samples, enhancing the ability to assess tissue microarchitecture. This innovative phase microscopy technology offers rapid, non-destructive volumetric imaging, which could significantly improve disease management and in-vivo assessments.

articles.title: Echo4DIR: 4D Implicit Heart Reconstruction from 2D Echocardiography Videos
articles.summary: Researchers have introduced Echo4DIR, a framework designed to reconstruct 4D cardiac geometry from 2D echocardiography videos, addressing challenges of geometric ambiguity and temporal discontinuity. The method utilizes statistical shape models and a cardiac conditional signed distance function to enhance the accuracy of heart shape reconstruction.
